import sys

MOD = 998244353


def solve() -> None:
    """斐波那契递推，滚动变量 + 取模"""
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a, b = 1, 1  # a = f(1), b = f(2)；滚动到 a = f(n+1)
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, (a + b) % MOD
    sys.stdout.write(str(a % MOD) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
